# A company holding US dollars while paying its own bills at home
#
# 1,000.00 USD bought at each of 1.20, 1.30, 1.40 and 1.50 — 5,400.00 for
# 4,000.00 dollars — and the rent paid in Canadian dollars throughout.
# 
# Nothing foreign is ever spent, so nothing is realized, and the holding
# is measured against all four purchases together. The rent moves
# total_assets every time and moves no gain at all.
#
# Generated by scripts/generate-multi-currency-examples.sh. Not a
# test fixture — no test draws its figures from here — but the
# statement below is checked against what the tool prints, by
# tests/integration/test_each_worked_example_still_prints_the_statement_it_carries.py.
# Check it yourself:
#
#     gnucash-plaintext import --new /tmp/check.gnucash \
#         examples/multi-currency/dollars_held_while_the_bills_are_paid_at_home.txt
#     gnucash-plaintext balance-sheet /tmp/check.gnucash --as-of 2026-12-31
#
# The statement that ledger produces is at the end of this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# What `balance-sheet --as-of 2026-12-31` prints for the book above.
#
# Commented, every line of it. A statement opens with a dated
# directive — `2026-12-31 balance-sheet` — and the import reads a
# line at column 0 as one, so a file carrying both would refuse to
# import and this example would not do the one thing it is for.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# 2026-12-31 balance-sheet
# 	# An account line is that account's own balance — never its children's.
# 	# A section total, and any figure no account holds, is a key.
# 	# share_price: and value: under an account line are what this report
# 	# valued the holding at on this date, not the rate a split happened at.
# 	#
# 	# A gain already taken is stated apart from one the book has yet to
# 	# take, and only the unrealized total reaches total_equity.
# 	# gnucash_balancing_amount is GnuCash's own figure, carried across so
# 	# the two can be read against each other, and added into nothing.
# 	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 	Assets:CAD Bank 3400.00 CAD
# 	Assets:USD Bank 4000.00 USD
# 		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 		share_price: "1.5"
# 		value: "6000.00"
# 	total_assets: 9400.00 CAD
# 	total_liabilities: 0.00 CAD
# 	Equity:Opening CAD 10000.00 CAD
# 	retained_earnings: -1200.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_assets_fx:
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				type: asset
# 				share_price: 1.5 # current price of commodity in balance sheet currency
# 				cost_bases:
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: 190ebc2167514a69962528803fe254f7
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 1000.00
# 						cost_share_price: 1.2 # USD in CAD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 1 # CAD per CAD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 1.2 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 1200.00 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 1500.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 300.00 # value - cost_value
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: 37799170a27c4ec9ab9de7073653a3be
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 1000.00
# 						cost_share_price: 1.3 # USD in CAD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 1 # CAD per CAD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 1.3 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 1300.00 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 1500.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 200.00 # value - cost_value
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: e0ec453824d84b389a48aae0a290e7e6
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 1000.00
# 						cost_share_price: 1.4 # USD in CAD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 1 # CAD per CAD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 1.4 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 1400.00 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 1500.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 100.00 # value - cost_value
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: a5f1463679704cf9b13dc83556afe196
# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 1000.00
# 						cost_share_price: 1.5 # USD in CAD, on the day it was bought
# 						cost_rate: 1 # CAD per CAD, on that same day
# 						cost_share_price_in_base: 1.5 # cost_share_price * cost_rate
# 						cost_value: 1500.00 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price_in_base
# 						value: 1500.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 				cost_basis_balance: 4000.00 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_basis_balance
# 				cost_value: 5400.00 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_value
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 52f714f94f2b4d76bf1137b11100d530
# 						name: "Assets:USD Bank"
# 						balance: 4000.00
# 				balance_value: 4000.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				value: 6000.00 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 				unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 600.00 # value - cost_value
# 		cost_value: 5400.00 # sum of each commodity's cost_value
# 		value: 6000.00 # sum of each commodity's value
# 		unrealized_gains_assets_fx: 600.00 # value - cost_value
# 	unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx: 0.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_fx: 600.00 CAD # unrealized_gains_assets_fx + unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx
# 	realized_gains_fx:
# 		realized_gains_fx: 0.00
# 		splits: # there is no split
# 	realized_gains_other: 0.00 CAD
# 	total_realized_gains: 0.00 CAD # realized_gains_fx + realized_gains_other
# 	unrealized_gains_other: # sum of unrealized_gains_other of all securities and funds
# 		securities: # there is no security or fund
# 		value: 0.00 # sum of each security's value
# 		cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each security's cost_value
# 		unrealized_gains_other: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 	total_unrealized_gains: 600.00 CAD # unrealized_gains_fx + unrealized_gains_other
# 	gnucash_balancing_amount: # the commodities GnuCash's own figure is summed from
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 				splits:
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 07ccf7bdd5f549dab684dad8f50efc62
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: 10000.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 33778931393b4d5e8155e13badcd7a4f
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: -1200.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: ec90cc6e50fe41fa9ff743158c98e85d
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: -400.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 4c2cb7ccef804c1ca3ef58cf3f0488c3
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: -1300.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 85ea7e2ed8614933b870e04d19c58dc8
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: -1400.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 9c227d4bc4c64142950ff9dcf21228f1
# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"
# 						value: -500.00

# 						account: "Assets:CAD Bank"

# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"

# 						account: "Assets:USD Bank"
